source_gap_prevention.goal: Reduce misses in legal and enforcement publications across existing EcoRadar and Hard Radar without new scheduled tasks, IDs, registry namespaces or repeated empty reports.

checks: date of secondary publication distinct from date of original document
mandatory cross-check primary/official text and effective edition

search_windows.priority_lag: A letter dated earlier but published only now counts as new.
search_windows.query_strategy: Browse topic category pages PLUS indexed search by issuer, number, date, issue, site; if site inaccessible use searchable cached/indexed results and state coverage as limited. Preserve old material as lead until verified.

required_per_cycle: record which sources were ACTUALLY checked (internal, not noisy user output)
source query + time window, extracted new IDs/letters and duplicate comparison
note explicitly when source unreachable, stale or results truncated
cross-check any consequential secondary item against law/source
coverage_quality_gate.not_claim: Do not claim 58 industries, all-source complete audit, or no missed items from one search / successful automation status.
coverage_quality_gate.minimum_crosscheck: At least two independent discovery paths for critical regulatory letters (e.g. official ministry or RPN + Consultant hotdocs / Garant where available).
coverage_quality_gate.escalation: If 2 or more consecutive cycles cannot access a critical discovery source, attempt alternate index and backfill. User alert only if substantial interruption requires user action.

handoff.ecoradar: Discover official NPA and non-normative letters; preserve state distinction and publication timestamp.
handoff.hard_radar: Trace enforcement/court/physical routes; check relevance to existing case and index; no duplicate IDs.
handoff.dedup: Compare document number + publication + topic + case number against latest GitHub master-index and cards.
handoff.release: GitHub readback -> index readback -> live batch and exact-ID full lookup; autonomous expert use separately tested. No pretending READ audit proves WRITE.

test_cases: Letter Minprirody 13.11.2026 No 25-77/48941 was published in Consultant hotdocs 23.11.2026, must be detected as new even though document date is 10 days older.
Letter 08.10.2026 No 12-47/43587 was later published in November and must be deduplicated.
Official RPN enforcement story may be available via regional source even if federal /press/news homepage is stale.
source_gap_prevention.user_output: Silence on routine sweeps. Alert only verified consequential novel findings, GitHub+Engine verified ingestion, or serious user-actionable failures.

judicial_forensic_hunt.purpose: Actively discover hard-to-notice environmental court decisions through physical pollution routes and evidence issues, even when there is no regulator news.
judicial_forensic_hunt.rule: Search BOTH by exact case number and by unusual failure modes; publication date may lag case date by weeks. For every high-value case: read judicial text, extract technical actual flow, documentary intended flow, measured contamination, alternative causes, evidence admissibility and precise remedy. Distinguish harm to soil/water, administrative penalties, NVOS fees. Connect to existing sector ID; do not create duplicate ID or promote isolated case to universal rule.

regression_anchor.expected_diagnostic: Check geo coordinates of permitted vs actual discharge and spill paths beyond lease boundary; verify soil measurements and causation; avoid conflating soil harm with water harm.

judicial_forensic_hunt.expert_routing: ECO_EXPERT; ROP_EXPERT only if actual recycling obligations implicated
judicial_forensic_hunt.release: RESEARCH_ONLY until source and historical law crosschecked, no unsupported universal rules
judicial_forensic_hunt.notification: Only real, confirmed, user-relevant results per output rule; no monitoring status spam.

expert_judicial_research.trigger: Expert request requiring judicial practice or high legal risk
expert_judicial_research.constraint: No automatic expert competence claims before full-text verification and independent regression tests
